payload.title: Pyleoclim figures with multiple panels
payload.description: This notebook demonstrates how to create multi-panel figures using the Pyleoclim library, which is built on top of Matplotlib. It focuses on combining individual plots into larger figures for enhanced visualization. The notebook generates time series data with fractal noise, applies various time alignment methods, and visualizes the results using Pyleoclim's plotting capabilities. The notebook is intended for users with basic knowledge of Python and Matplotlib.
